entries.title: Scalar assumption aircraft models
entries.resolution: The v0.8 pack makes assumption-backed named fixtures explicitly UNSUPPORTED for named-performance consumers. The governed aircraft-evidence registry prevents a pack from self-admitting with arbitrary hashes. The generic three-configuration regression proves the existing table/control boundary changes recorded turn, climb, acceleration, and fuel state in TS/Rust parity, but does not validate the assumptions or retire this row. Retire this entry only after every required capability has immutable source and independent validation evidence and #64 reference-validation criteria pass.

entries.title: Assumption weapon models and powered glide proxy
entries.resolution: Replace with variant-specific weapon packs and remove the powered glide proxy.

entries.title: Database weapon lookup falls back to in-memory models
entries.resolution: Compile one admitted immutable model pack; reject missing models.

entries.title: Named actor identities remain in the compiled movement contract
entries.resolution: Allocate actor identities from the authored force package instead of fixed duel slots.

entries.title: Observer state is fail-closed until an admitted sensor pack exists
entries.resolution: Compile independently validated versioned sensor data and an owned observation-to-track state machine. Require distinct source/validation artifacts and validated range, scan, FOV, uncertainty, and target-applicability bounds before a positive sensor can compile. Bind every tick admission field exactly to the compiler-produced sensor projection, preserve the fail-closed state whenever that data is absent or outside its validity envelope, and retire the separate STUB-07 binding transport.

entries.title: Declared circular sensor and weapon envelopes
entries.resolution: Render computed sensing, support, and engagement states from the canonical run.

entries.title: Temporary runtime model-pack adapter
entries.resolution: Transport the versioned compiled pack and canonical VSR contracts directly.

entries.title: Playback reconstructs missing WGS84 coordinates
entries.resolution: Record geographic state or mark the geographic layer unsupported.

entries.title: Report sample fixture and saved-run absence boundary
entries.resolution: Construct the example report only for explicit sample mode; fail closed when a saved run or its library identity is unavailable. #41/#32 still require end-to-end saved-run replay evidence before retirement.

entries.title: Source-less public-reference catalogue records
entries.resolution: Supply field evidence or make the named object unavailable.

entries.title: Rust legacy runner converts errors into invalid-run records
entries.resolution: Return typed errors and prevent invalid records from satisfying success paths.

entries.title: Weapon behavior inferred from identifiers
entries.resolution: Load seeker, support, propulsion, guidance, and warning behavior from the admitted weapon variant.

entries.title: Fixed sensor, warning, intent, and recommit constants
entries.resolution: Use admitted sensor and behavior packs with independent validation.

entries.title: Weapon authorization ignores compiled geometry and support fields
entries.resolution: Use one geometry and weapon-support contract for launch and flyout.

entries.title: Intent and support accept arbitrary strings
entries.resolution: Use exhaustive typed enums and reject unknown states in both engines.

entries.title: AEW warning ignores datalink dependency
entries.resolution: Gate warning on admitted sensor, track, and datalink state.

entries.title: No-launch telemetry aliases aircraft as weapon
entries.resolution: Represent absent weapon state explicitly.

entries.title: Disabled-domain routes silently open A2A
entries.resolution: Return an unavailable-domain state from the centralized capability manifest.

entries.title: Saved-run admission invents causal fields
entries.resolution: Reject or explicitly migrate incomplete records without invented behavior.

entries.title: Condition and comparison controls advertise ungoverned runs
entries.resolution: Remove controls until each variant produces a governed canonical run.

entries.title: Geometry diagram and map layer controls are not canonical consumers
entries.resolution: Drive geometry and layer availability from the selected canonical frame.

entries.title: Active run errors can remain invisible
entries.resolution: Render typed loading, failed, stale, unsupported, and recovery states.

entries.title: Report export substitutes a generic weapon profile
entries.resolution: Reject a report whose run lacks its admitted weapon model identity.

entries.title: Air mission aircraft ground-performance envelope remains an explicit model assumption
entries.resolution: Keep the model-pack-bound runway length, surface and tailwind compatibility envelope explicit and fail-closed; replace the scalar educational envelope with immutable validated aircraft ground-performance evidence. Runway geometry and provenance are separately sourced by the issue #61 EnvironmentPack contract.

exemptions.rationale: The enum declares a value state and does not supply a model value.
Migration 009 preserves non-causal display metadata for compatibility; regional runtime authority is supplied by immutable environment_packs from migration 014.
The scalar terrain/weather values remain display and blank-draft metadata only; compiler/runtime authority resolves the exact sourced regional pack.
These lines declare provenance vocabulary, historical Phase A compatibility, and the visible bounded runway/DEM assumption; sourced regional runtime never silently falls back.
The public-educational runway/DEM reconciliation is explicitly labelled, content-bound, limited to 30 m, reported, and fails closed outside its envelope.
The type, default-loadout rows, and review-state mapping explicitly disclose assumption state; they do not promote those defaults to sourced or runtime authority.
The validator recognizes and constrains assumption-tagged catalog assertions; it does not supply an executable model value.
The source-freeze validator verifies a closed descriptive availability vocabulary; it supplies no executable model value.
The text discloses STUB-02 to the operator.
This comment describes keeping the non-causal map surface usable after initialization failure.
This comment states that engine selection does not silently fall through.
The page labels calculated display values; it does not supply runtime truth.
The HTTP error helper requires an explicit status default and does not supply causal state.
Reading-time presentation defaults do not enter simulation state.
These expressions select the runtime-stub policy files; they do not mark unfinished production behavior.
